meta.title: Tower Reviewer preset
meta.description: The independent Tower Reviewer preset: a read-only reviewer agent that reads the mission diff, checks scope and acceptance, and returns a verdict. Usable while review before merging is optional; a precondition for merging once review before merging is required. When off: The reviewer cannot be started. That is supported while review before merging is optional; once review before merging is required, planning and entering Tower mode are refused with an explanation.
